senses.gloss:
स्थ (ष्ठ) standing, living, being in, occupied with,
devoted to (—˚).

2 स्था॑ (nom. m. n. स्था॑स्) standing (often —˚), immovable
(opp. ज॑गत्).
स्थग् स्थगयति pp. स्थगित cover, hide, conceal.
स्थगन n. covering, hiding.
स्थगु m. hunch.
स्थडु m. hunch.

स्थण्डिल a. levelled piece of ground prepared for a
sacrifice, place, spot, ground i.g.
स्थण्डिलशय्या f. abstr. to seq.
स्थण्डिल˚शायिका f. abstr. to seq.
स्थण्डिलशायिन् a. lying on the bare ground.

स्थप॑ति m. chief or governor of a district;
 architect.

स्थपुट a. rugged, uneven, hump-backed;
 n. a hump.
स्थपुटगत a. belonging to a hump (flesh).

स्थल n. raised or dry ground, land (opp. water), earth,
ground, place, spot;
 स्थली f. mound, eminence (also स्थ॑ला),
ground, spot.
स्थलकमल n. ˚लिनी f. the flowering shrub.
स्थलग a. land-going, living on dry land.
स्थल˚चर a. land-going, living on dry land.
स्थलज a. land-born, terrestrial.
स्थलस्थ a. standing (being) on dry ground.
स्थलारूढ a. alighted on the ground.
स्थली v. स्थल.
स्थलीदेवता f. a local divinity.
स्थलीय् स्थली˚यति take for dry land.
स्थलीशायिन् a. lying on the bare ground.
स्थ॑विमन् m. the thick end, the broad side.

स्थ॑विर f. आ & ई thick, broad, firm, massy, sturdy;
full-grown, old, venerable.
स्थाविर n. old age.
स्थ॑विष्ठ (superl.) thickest, grossest.
स्थ॑वीयंस् (compar.) thicker, grosser, sturdier.
स्थश॑स् adv. according to the place.
स्थाणवीय a. belonging to Śiva (cf. seq.).

स्थाणुभूत a. (being) immovable as the trunk of a
tree.
स्थाणूच्छेद a. who roots out the trunks of trees.
स्थातव्य n. imp. (it is) to be stood or remained.
1 स्थातृ॑ a. standing, stationary.
2 स्था॑तृ m. guide (of horses).
स्थात्र॑ n. station, place.
स्थानपति m. protector of a place or region.
स्थान˚पाल m. protector of a place or region.
स्थानभङ्ग m. ruin of a place.
स्थानभ्रंश m. loss of a place.

स्थानभ्रष्ट^1 a. removed from one's place.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: anusvAra is wrong here. cf mw, pw.

स्थानयोग m. pl. the various places or modes for
keeping goods.
स्थानविद् a. knowing a place (places).
स्थानस्थ a. standing (being) at one's place.
स्थान˚स्थित a. standing (being) at one's place.
स्थानान्तर n. another place.
स्थानासन n. du. standing and sitting down.

स्थानासेध m. confinement to a certain place,
imprisonment.
स्थानीय a. being in or instead of (—˚).
स्थानेश्वर m. = स्थानपति.

स्थापक m. erector (of an image), establisher, founder;
a cert. person of the stage-business.
स्थापत्य n. the office of a स्थप॑ति.
स्थापनीय a. to be fixed or kept.

स्था॑प्य a. to be established, fixed, placed in (loc. or
acc.), kept, confined, restrained.
2 स्थामन् n. neighing of a horse.
स्थायिता f. ˚त्व n. duration.
स्था॑रश्मन् a. having firm reins.
स्थालीपाक॑ m. a kind of cooked offering.
स्थावरक m. N. of a servant.
स्थावरजङ्गम n. the immovable and movable.
स्थावरता f. condition of being a plant.
स्थावरत्व n. immobility.
स्था˚विर्य n. old age.
स्थासक s. perfume or unguent.
स्थास्नु a. stationary, immovable, firm, constant.
